summary: ACCEPT. Refutation attempts found no blocker or SHOULD-FIX. V4 separates physical death observation from the final appended death event, drains before death, and neither starts nor restarts a J-5 ladder against a dead child. Its provider-owned behavioral linearization point totally orders Cancel against concurrent terminal events and supplies success, rejection, and failed-commit branches without giving the control plane provider authority. G20 names the required race/failure traces, and the strict v3-to-v4 diff is confined to the closed roster, including reMeasurementAtV4. The candidate remains non-applying, chooses no SDK API, mints no D-096 (A), D9, exit, fate, or owner grant, leaves DR-125 OPEN, and authorizes no implementation.
